R and Quarto for reproducible analyses, and the intuition behind the core statistical tools, mostly through simulation.

Each session: slides and live code, then exercises, then solutions together. Material appears here session by session.

### Before the first session

Follow the [setup](setup.qmd).

### Datasets

All in [`data/`](https://github.com/giuseppealfonzetti/s4ns-A/tree/main/data). Each exercise page links the ones it uses: save them in the `data` folder of your project. Sources and licences: [data README](https://github.com/giuseppealfonzetti/s4ns-A/blob/main/data/README.md).
